principles.hol4_migration: HOL4 and OpenTheory/Dedukti are migration inputs/intermediates. Accepted migrated proof material is recursively quoted by MetaRocq into PCUIC and retained as a PCUICAst.Env.program.
principles.dedukti: Dedukti/Lambdapi terms are independently checked provenance artifacts, not the final project metatheory representation.
principles.rocq_transport: Generated Rocq source is a kernel-checking transport shell. It is not the canonical stored semantics when an equivalent PCUIC program is available.
principles.rust_native_metatheory: The Rust-native MetaRocq-rs metatheory should be specified directly over PCUIC-compatible syntax, environments, universes, typing and operational relations. HOL4 must not become a parallel authoritative metatheory.
principles.hol4_role: HOL4 remains a later independent verification/replay substrate after primary PCUIC formalization and implementation, except where prior HOL4 work is mechanically harvested into PCUIC.
principles.implementation: Implementation roadmaps and proof-transport certificates should consume the PCUIC canonical contract rather than HOL4 theory files.
